_comment: Hand-maintained mapping from Anthropic's public docs to pricing.json entries.
No model list is held here: the pricing page lists the models, and the
deprecations page states their ids and whether they are still sold.
`source`, the pricing page, is read for its tables, which are rendered on the
server: the model table, the batch table, the fast mode table and the Claude
Managed Agents table. Each is found by its header rows, word for word, below in
`tables`; a table headed any other way is not read, and a page where one of these
is missing, or found twice, fails the run. Every price cell states its unit,
'/ MTok', and a cell in any other form fails the run too.
`status_source`, the deprecations page, is read for its status table: the API id
of every current and recently retired model, and its state. A priced name is
matched to its id by the format Anthropic's 'Model IDs and versions' page states:
'Claude Opus 4.5' is claude-opus-4-5, followed by -YYYYMMDD before the 4.6
generation. `states` says which states are still sold. A Retired model is not
published even when the pricing page still prices it, as it did Claude Opus 4.1,
Opus 4 and Sonnet 4 on 2026-11-10. A state not named in `states` fails the run.
Not published, and why (scripts/providers/anthropic/README.md says more):
the 1.1x multiplier for US-only inference (inference_geo), a rule and not a price;
the prompt caching multipliers on fast mode prices, which the page states as a
rule and no figure; the partner clouds (Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud), which set
their own prices on their own pages.
_comment_restricted: A model whose name carries this badge is not published, in any table: on 2026-11-10
the pricing page marked the Claude Mythos models '(Verification required)', sold only
to organisations Anthropic has verified. The badge is an icon; its words are what it
says to a screen reader, its aria-label.
_comment_tables: `headers` is every header row of the table, cell by cell. `columns` is the price
columns after the name, in order, and the field each becomes. A model priced on
two rows, 'for prompts up to N tokens' then 'for prompts over N tokens', gets its
second row in the `_long_context` twin of each field, and long_context_threshold
N + 1: the prompt of N tokens is still billed at the first row's prices.
_comment_products: Tools and products, keyed by the tool's name in the API where it has one. Three
are priced in a sentence, matched by `sentence`: its `amount` is the figure, and
a sentence with no `amount` says the product is free (`field` null). A sentence
that is gone, or found twice with two figures, fails the run. Claude Managed
Agents is priced in a table, found by `headers`, in the row named `row`.
Code execution: Anthropic also gives every organisation 1,550 free container hours
a month, and makes it free when web search or web fetch is in the same request.
Neither fits a price field; the README says both.

web_search.sentence: Web search is available on the Claude API for \$(?P<amount>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?) USD per 1,000 searches

code_execution.sentence: Additional usage beyond [0-9,]+ hours is billed at \$(?P<amount>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?) USD per hour, per container

web_fetch.sentence: The web fetch tool is available on the Claude API at no additional cost
